summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for Per-query fusion weighting; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] In Atlas Hybrid Fusion, the `weight` parameter is an optional Double that multiplies the `score` expression by a number after normalization. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/score.md

In Elastic's linear retriever, each retriever's `weight` multiplies its scores, must be >= 0 and defaults to 1.0. In Azure AI Search, the vector weighting multiplier defaults to 1.0 (no weighting) and is applied to the initial score before RRF scoring. Sources: https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/elasticsearch/rest-apis/retrievers/linear-retriever ; https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/search/hybrid-search-ranking

In MongoDB's $rankFusion stage, the `scoreDetails` option defaults to `false`; when set to `true`, $rankFusion computes a `scoreDetails` metadata field for each document containing information about the final ranking, which is not output unless projected (for example with $project or $addFields). $scoreFusion likewise creates a `scoreDetails` metadata field when set to true and by default does not output it. The wording about analyzing why a document matched and received its score describes the $search stage's scoreDetails, a separate feature. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankFusion.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scoreFusion.md

[low] MongoDB recommends weighing lexical and vector queries on a per-query basis rather than using static weights for all queries to improve result relevance. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md

[medium] In Atlas Hybrid Fusion, pipeline weights default to `1` if unspecified, must be non-negative numbers (whole or decimal), and can be `0`. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scoreFusion.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankFusion.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview.md

[low] The weighted reciprocal rank score in Atlas Hybrid Fusion is calculated using the formula: weight x reciprocal rank. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/vector-search-with-full-text-search.md
[low] Calibrating weights per query at production scale is considered not practical. Sources: https://redis.io/blog/reciprocal-rank-fusion/
